result:
Big workspace, not single crate. 236 members under `crates/`, root `Cargo.toml` just list workspace members + shared deps. This Zed editor.

**Size:** ~236 crates. Huge.

**Main pieces:**

- `gpui` — core UI/app framework (own render, entity, concurrency system). Everything build on top. Platform backends split: `gpui_macos`, `gpui_linux`, `gpui_windows`, `gpui_wgpu`, `gpui_web`.
- `editor` — text editing core (buffer view, cursors, multi-cursor, etc), depend on `text`, `rope`, `multi_buffer`, `buffer_diff`.
- `language` / `language_core` / `lsp` — syntax, language config, Language Server Protocol client.
- `project` — project model, file tree, cross-file state. `worktree` — file watching/indexing per dir.
- `workspace` — pane/dock/window layout container for editor+panels.
- `zed` — main binary crate, wire everything together.
- Collab stack: `collab`, `rpc`, `proto`, `channel`, `call` — realtime collab server+client.
- Git stack: `git`, `git_ui`, `git_hosting_providers`, `git_graph`.
- AI/agent stack (big, recent growth): `agent`, `agent_ui`, `agent_servers`, `language_model`, `language_models`, plus per-provider crates (`anthropic`, `open_ai`, `google_ai`, `bedrock`, `ollama`, `mistral`, `deepseek`, `x_ai`, `open_router`, `copilot`, `copilot_chat`, `lmstudio`, `codestral`), `edit_prediction*` (Zeta), `acp_thread`/`acp_tools` (agent client protocol).
- `debugger_ui`/`dap`/`dap_adapters` — Debug Adapter Protocol / debugger.
- `extension`/`extension_host`/`extension_api`/`extension_cli` — extension system.
- `terminal`/`terminal_view` — embedded terminal.
- `ui`/`ui_input`/`ui_macros`/`theme*` — design system, widgets, theming.
- `settings`/`settings_content`/`settings_ui`/`settings_json` — config system.
- `db`/`sqlez`/`sqlez_macros` — sqlite persistence layer.
- `vim`/`vim_mode_setting` — vim emulation.

Pattern: split fine-grain by concern (one crate per provider, per UI panel, per protocol piece). Root `zed` crate wire it all into app.
